summary: Authenticate incoming seat freshness against only the pushed seats instead of decoding the entire desired inventory

replay.detail: Claim replay and projection writes are unchanged.

schema.detail: Uses the existing desired subject primary key; no new tables or indexes.

rules.detail: The same decoded member-host check authenticates each pushed seat. Missing, stopped and unreadable members remain unrecorded.

compatibility.detail: No wire or response changes. Only incoming freshness candidate discovery changes; other desired inventory consumers are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon update; no migration or downtime required.

recovery.detail: Revert the read-path change; no stored state changes.
